title: Score Measure Payload
description: One row per measure unit (ms3 'mc') in score order; columns are parallel arrays. Every DLC measure TSV column except quarterbeats, quarterbeats_all_endings and duration_qb is reconstructed exactly from the payload. The quarters_interval.fraction extent start is quarterbeats_all_endings (falling back to quarterbeats), and its duration is 4 * act_dur. The unfolded quarterbeats column (which differs from quarterbeats_all_endings after a volta) and duration_qb (equal to 4 * act_dur in all DLC rows) are not stored, by design.

mc.description: Measure counts: 1-based index of the measure unit in the encoded score (ms3 'mc').

mn.description: Printed measure numbers; 0 for an anacrusis, repeated for split measures.

keysig.description: Key signatures as signed numbers of sharps, with flats negative.

timesig.description: Time signatures as notated, e.g. '3/4', '12/16', '33/32'; strings distinguish 6/8 from 3/4.

act_dur.description: Actual lengths of measure units in whole notes, e.g. [1, 4] for a quarter-note anacrusis.

mc_offset.description: Offsets of each unit's first event from the start of the logical measure, in whole notes; non-zero for anacruses and the second part of split measures; may be negative when a measure unit is longer than its time signature.

next.description: Lists of mc values that can follow each unit in performance order; -1 means end of the piece, e.g. [2], [1, 9], [9, -1]. The minItems: 1 constraint deliberately makes empty next lists (which ms3 can emit for unreachable units) unrepresentable.

numbering_offset.description: ms3 numbering offsets applied to mn; null when not set.

dont_count.description: True when the measure is excluded from the bar count (TSV '1'); null otherwise (TSV empty).

barline.description: Barline text verbatim; observed: double, end, start-repeat, end-repeat, end-start-repeat, dotted, dashed. Null for an empty TSV cell.

breaks.description: Break text verbatim; observed: line, page, section, 'page & section', 'section & page'. Null for an empty TSV cell.

repeats.description: Repeat text verbatim; observed: firstMeasure, lastMeasure, start, end, startend. Null for an empty TSV cell.

markers.description: Marker text verbatim; observed: fine, segno, coda, codab, 1e, 2e, 3e, 4e. Null for an empty TSV cell.

jump_bwd.description: Backward jump text verbatim; observed: start, segno. Null for an empty TSV cell.

jump_fwd.description: Forward jump text verbatim; observed: coda, 2e, 3e, 4e. Null for an empty TSV cell.

play_until.description: Play-until text verbatim; observed: fine, end, segno, '/'. Null for an empty TSV cell.
